life_event: Diana was the first of seven children.
Diana’s brother, Adam, is born in Bailey County, Texas
Diana’s sister, Virginia, is born in Parmer County, Texas
Dropped out of school, faked physical illness
Married Rodolfo Carrillo (18) and moved to Bovina, Texas (Bragg, 1990) Tired of her flirtatious behavior, Rodolfo left Diana. Diana met Lionel Garza (who
would later become her second husband)
Gave birth to daughter, Melissa Lumbrera, in Bovina, Texas

Gave birth to daughter, Joanna Lumbrera, in Friona, Texas Killed Joanna Lumbrera (HF, 3 months old) in her home in Friona, Texas. Joanna was 11/30/1976 dead on arrival when Diana brought her to the Parmer County Community Hospital. 18 Strangulation due to aspiration of stomach contents. Married Lionel G. Garza (19) in Parmer County, Texas (Source: Texas Marriage 02/19/1977 Collection, 1814-1909 and 1966-2002) 11/28/1977 Gave birth to son, Luís Garza, in Clovis, Curry County, New Mexico. Killed Luís Garza (HM, 2 ½ months old) in her home in Friona, Texas. Luís was dead 02/13/1978 19 on arrival when Diana brought him to the Parmer County Community Hospital. Killed Melissa Lumbrera (HF, 3 years old) in her home. Melissa was dead on arrival 10/02/1978 when Diana took her to the Parmer County Community Hospital in Friona, Texas. 11/29/1979 Gave birth to daughter, Melinda Ann Garza, in Muleshoe, Texas. Went for a drive with her cousin’s daughter, Ericka Leonor Aleman. Thirty minutes 21 10/08/1980 later, Ericka (HF, 6 weeks old) is dead on arrival when Diana brings her to West Plains Medical Hospital in Muleshoe, Texas.
Lionel Garza files for divorce Killed Melinda Lumbrera (HF, 3 years old) in her home. Melinda was pronounced
dead at her home in Friona, Texas.
Lionel’s and Diana’s divorce becomes official

Gave birth to son, Christopher Daniel Marcos, in Clovis, New Mexico. 03/08/1984 Had an abortion and received a prescription for birth control pills 25 Killed Christopher Daniel Marcos (HM, 5 ½ months old) in her home. Daniel was 03/28/1984 dead on arrival when Diana took him to Plains Memorial Hospital in Dimmitt, Texas.
Diana’s mother died in Bovina, Texas, at the age of 46 1985 Diana moves to Garden City, Kansas

Gave birth to son, José Antonio Lumbrera, in Garden City, Kansas Killed Jose Antonio Lumbrera (HM, 4 years old) in her home. José was dead on arrival 05/01/1990 when Diana took him to St. Catherine’s Hospital in Garden City, Kansas.

Arrested in Kansas for alleged murder of José Antonio Lumbrera 06/12/1990 Had preliminary hearing in Kansas 10/03/1990 Convicted for the death of José Antonio Lumbrera Late 1990/ Investigation and trial in Texas Early 1991 32 Found guilty of murder in the first degree for the deaths of Melissa, Melinda, and 04/23/1991 Daniel 06/1991 Began serving her time in a Kansas prison
Diana’s father died in Clovis, New Mexico
Began serving time in the Mountain View Unit of a Texas prison 11/18/2012 Still serving time in Texas as of November 18, 2012
